evidence_scope: Backend PostgreSQL component acceptance only; no native/game/registration E2E claim.

entries.contract: 伪造/迟到ACTIVE报告不使托管Attempt或投影提前Running；报告关闭也不丢冻结名单；源状态和投影合法一致。
entries.observed: The real metaserver PostgreSQL cases reject a pre-running report without changing CONNECTING/RESERVED, accept a completed late report without mutating match/server/attempt lifecycle, keep standalone PvE and retired Meta records non-official and unchanged, and preserve frozen roster identity. The new Dedicated component assertion closes the no-report path: completing the attempt leaves the two-seat frozen roster and Meta projection intact. This is a Backend component PASS; it does not claim a game/native BattleLog E2E.
assertions: Backend/internal/metaserver/battlelog_repository_integration_test.go:195-214 rejects premature-report and asserts CONNECTING/RESERVED unchanged.
Backend/internal/metaserver/battlelog_repository_integration_test.go:311-380 asserts standalone PvE does not discover/complete retired Meta and explicit retired report/loadout are forbidden.
Backend/internal/matchlobby/dedicated_integration_test.go:484-496 completes with no BattleLog report, compares Meta projection to frozen roster, and asserts COUNT(match_attempt_roster)=2.

entries.contract: 旧server或native_unverified不能被选为strict authority；新server分配后普通READY心跳不使其二次入池。
entries.observed: A real isolated PostgreSQL component test prepared a READY legacy strict-roster-v1 candidate with the correct game hash and a READY strict-roster-v2 candidate with verified=false and the correct game hash; formal MatchLobby.Start rejected both with MATCH_LOBBY_NO_DEDICATED_SERVER and left them READY. A strict verified candidate was allocated through MatchLobby.Start, then gameserver.Service.Heartbeat(READY) returned/persisted RESERVED while its Attempt was PROVISIONING; a second ready lobby could not allocate it. The candidate rows and gst_ fixture are Service-boundary test fixtures, not registration or signed-HTTP E2E evidence.
assertions: Backend/internal/matchlobby/dedicated_integration_test.go:60-87 keeps legacy version and unverified predicate isolated and asserts both remain READY after Start rejection.
Backend/internal/matchlobby/dedicated_integration_test.go:99-127 allocates verified strict candidate and invokes formal gameserver.Service.Heartbeat(READY), asserting RESERVED in result and DB.
Backend/internal/matchlobby/dedicated_integration_test.go:130-135 attempts a second real Start and asserts MATCH_LOBBY_NO_DEDICATED_SERVER.
Backend/internal/matchlobby/service.go:649-665 is the production strict candidate query requiring verified=true, locked game hash, and strict-roster-v2.
Backend/internal/gameserver/service.go:256-281 is the production assignment/cleanup heartbeat protection.
